objectives: 無人機技術作為遙測工具的應用，是一項創新且新興的技術發展。本課程以航空動力學原理為基礎，介紹定翼與旋翼型無人機的操作原理，並以航空攝影應用為主軸，說明飛行與航拍任務的規劃方式。透過實作操作，學生將親自設計與組裝無人機，進行航拍任務，並產製空間資訊成果，如正射影像與地形模型，進一步應用於地理資訊系統（GIS）分析。
content:
Outline：
Week 1 - Course Introduction and Overview of UAV Applications and Trends
Week 2 - Fundamentals of Aerodynamics I: Lift, Thrust, and Gravity
Week 3 - Fundamentals of Aerodynamics II: Stability and Control
Week 4 - Introduction and Comparison of Fixed-Wing and Rotary-Wing UAVs
Week 5 - UAV Flight Control Systems and Sensors
Week 6 - UAV Regulations, Safety Procedures, and Flight Permit Applications
Week 7 - Aerial Mission Planning: Flight Path Design and Parameter Settings
Week 8 - UAV Assembly and Simulation Testing (Practical)
Week 9 - Flight Training and Manual/Autonomous Operation (Practical)
Week 10 - Aerial Photography and Imaging Techniques
Week 11 - Image Alignment and Orthorectification Principles
Week 12 - Processing Aerial Data: Point Clouds, DSM, and DTM
Week 13 - Using UAV Data for GIS Map Production
Week 14 - UAV Applications in Environmental Monitoring and Disaster Assessment
Week 15 - Student Project Presentations and Discussions
Week 16 - Course Review, Final Exam / Report Submission
books:
1.	Unmanned Aircraft Systems: UAVS Design, Development and Deployment, P.G. Fahlstrom & T. J. Gleason, Wiley
2.	Introduction to Photogrammetry, T Schenk, Ohio State University
3.	Introduction to UAV Systems (4th ed.): Paul G. Fahlstrom & Thomas J. Gleason, Wiley
4.	Unmanned Aircraft Systems: The Definitive Guide: Reg Austin, Wiley
5.	Small Unmanned Aircraft: Theory and Practice: Randal W. Beard & Timothy W. McLain, Princeton University Press
6.	Remote Sensing and Image Interpretation (7th ed.): Thomas M. Lillesand, Ralph W. Kiefer, Jonathan Chipman, Wiley
7.	GIS and the 2020 Census: Modernizing Official Statistics: John R. Weeks et al., Esri Press
